prs.title: fix(server): stop replay cleanly when streamable HTTP replay stream c…
prs.author: meirk-brd
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: SSE replay-after-reconnect is broken in two sequential ways: (1) when a client disconnects mid-replay the server has no graceful handling for the closed stream controller, and (2) when the client reconnects with Last-Event-ID the EventStore's event-selection logic uses a plain string comparison (`eventId > lastEventId`) rather than anchoring on the last seen event and filtering by streamId, so the wrong events are replayed. Both bugs manifest in the same user-facing scenario and neither fix alone produces correct end-to-end behaviour. (2 PRs)

PR #2152 only touches test-file EventStore implementations. The production transport fix in #1681 should be the anchor; the corrected event-selection logic from #2152 should be folded into it so a single PR ships both layers of the fix.
